svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Rendered with orrery (github.com/Sagargupta16/orrery): # orrery render docs/diagrams/submission-pipeline.yaml -o docs/diagrams/submission-pipeline -f svg --theme both # Reviewed at README width: orrery review docs/diagrams/submission-pipeline.yaml --width 880 title: How a submission gets listed subtitle: From a fork pull request or the issue form to the website, plus a monthly audit of every entry direction: right layout: { spacing: compact, aspect: 1.0 } legend: dashed: Monthly schedule # The stage skin's packet walks the form path, the one with no human step after the form. story: [contributor, form, issue2pr, pr, star, automerge, main, site]
groups: # The main ruleset's required status checks (Validate format, Lint and test the gate # scripts, Check links, Check submitted entries): auto-merge waits for all of them. required: { type: box, label: Required checks }
nodes: contributor: { icon: github:person, label: Contributor, evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:26#Fork } form: icon: github:issue-opened label: Suggest a server note: Issue form align: contributor evidence: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/add-server.yml:4#addition pr: icon: github:git-pull-request label: Pull request note: One README row evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:30#pull issue2pr: icon: github:workflow label: Issue to PR note: issue_to_pr.py align: pr evidence: [.github/workflows/issue-to-pr.yml:120#issue_to_pr, .github/workflows/issue-to-pr.yml:162#create] lint: icon: github:checklist label: Lint note: validate.py, ruff, pytest, links in: required evidence: [.github/workflows/lint.yml:50#validate, .github/workflows/lint.yml:79#Lint, .github/workflows/lint.yml:85#Test, .github/workflows/lint.yml:92#links] submission: icon: github:shield-check label: Submission check note: Licence, last push, real MCP in: required evidence: .github/workflows/submission-check.yml:35#entries star: icon: github:star label: Star gate note: missing-star until the author stars evidence: [.github/workflows/star-check.yml:55#star_check, .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml:120#star_check] automerge: icon: github:git-merge label: Auto merge note: README or CHANGELOG only evidence: .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml:129#squash main: icon: github:git-branch label: main note: README.md evidence: .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml:28#main site: icon: github:globe label: Website note: GitHub Pages, live stars evidence: [.github/workflows/pages.yml:89#build_site, .github/workflows/pages.yml:109#deploy-pages] thanks: icon: github:comment label: Thank contributors note: Comments a badge evidence: .github/workflows/thanks.yml:66#thank_contributors health: icon: github:pulse label: List health note: staleness_report.py evidence: .github/workflows/health.yml:30#staleness_report report: icon: github:issue-tracks label: Health report note: Issue labelled maintenance evidence: .github/workflows/health.yml:45#maintenance
edges: - contributor -> pr: fork PR - contributor -> form - form -> issue2pr - issue2pr -> pr - pr -> required - pr -> star - required -> automerge: all green - star -> automerge: starred - automerge -> main - main -> site - main -> thanks - main --> health - health -> report

svg.title: How a submission gets listed
svg.desc: How a submission gets listed. 13 components in 1 groups. Connections: Contributor to Pull request (fork PR); Contributor to Suggest a server; Suggest a server to Issue to PR; Issue to PR to Pull request; Pull request to Required checks; Pull request to Star gate; Required checks to Auto merge (all green); Star gate to Auto merge (starred); Auto merge to main; main to Website; main to Thank contributors; main to List health; List health to Health report.

text.tspan: From a fork pull request or the issue form to the website, plus a monthly audit of every entry
